items.title: ‘Road to Everest’ shares Nepal’s Himalayan story with Hong Kong audiences
items.summary: Hong Kong, November 2 A special screening of the documentary Road to Everest was held in Hong Kong on Sunday under the theme “Experience Everest, Support Rasuwa”, drawing an enthusiastic audience. Organised by the Non-Resident Nepali Association (NRNA) Hong Kong, the screening took place at Sunbeam Whampoa Cinema in Hung Hom. items.title: Bhotekoshi floods leave older survivors grappling with loss, uncertainty and trauma
items.summary: Two months on, many elderly survivors remain displaced, haunted by memories of the disaster and waiting for news of missing family members. Authorities are yet to establish how many older people were affected.
